state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `the-pipeline-bench-has-no-nested-twin` is closed. A bench may now have a sibling `<name>.twin.nvs`: the same operation written another way. `--record-perf` times it in the same sweep and records `twin_ns_per_op` and `twin_ratio` (the bench's figure over the twin's). It is a figure, never a finding. `benches/members/README.md` § *What a bench declares* documents it, and the comment check covers the twin. `benches/members/lang/expressions/the-pipeline-operator.twin.nvs` writes the three calls nested; its first record gives a twin ratio of 0.97x.

A `decimal` *property* default is still refused (`E0472`), because `nvs_runtime::FieldDefault` has no `decimal` recipe. The module doc of `crates/nvs-types/src/defaults.rs` says so.

`startsWith` and `endsWith` still compare bytes. Whether they join the search family is still open.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest: 26 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-types`, `nvs-runtime`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

items.text: **The live-chain-entry test reads the live goal from the chain record** (`data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/the-live-chain-entry-test-names-a-goal-stage-6-deletes.json`). `an_owner_that_is_not_a_live_chain_entry_fails` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/spec_registry_coverage.rs:616` asserts the walked goal `carried-gaps` is on the chain, and Stage 6 deletes it. Take the slug from `data/chain.json`'s `live` instead, then delete the gap (`rule:tooling/the-chain-names-its-live-goal`).
